rows.grounds: Fused compound: liṅga-saṃsthāpanasya (of liṅga-installation) + ukta (stated) + vartmanā (by-path); instrumental expresses the means or procedure.
Qualifies kriyām as the whole or complete rite.
Object of the implied action of performing, continuing the ritual instruction from the preceding verses.

items.question: Which prescribed procedure governs the performance of the entire ritual?
premises: A procedure is stated for liṅga installation.
The entire ritual is the object to be performed.
The stated procedure serves as the governing path.
items.inference: The entire ritual is to be performed according to the procedure stated for liṅga installation.
uncertainties: The governing verb is implied from the preceding verses rather than expressed in this verse.
items.plain_english: One should perform the entire rite by the path prescribed for the installation of the liṅga.
